heading: Your Evidence Lab setup
intro: Based on your answers, this is the complete set of research capabilities I recommend:
details: Number of capabilities: {count}. Application: {host}. Stable version: {release}.
confirmation: Would you like me to add this complete setup?

packs.title: Research foundation
packs.purpose: Source checks, citations, critical review, personal skill creation, and reproducible Evidence Lab setup.

packs.title: PDF and document evidence
packs.purpose: Turns supported documents into inspectable material for analysis.

packs.title: Literature and publication
packs.purpose: Supports literature synthesis, academic writing, diagrams, and manuscript review.

packs.title: Research design
packs.purpose: Helps formulate testable hypotheses and defensible study or experiment designs.

packs.title: Tables and datasets
packs.purpose: Supports reproducible data retrieval and exploratory data-quality analysis.

packs.title: Quantitative methods
packs.purpose: Adds statistics, power analysis, uncertainty, units, and scientific visualization.

packs.title: Life-science checks
packs.purpose: Adds protocol, control, bias, biosafety, and reporting checks for life-science work.

packs.title: Publication monitoring
packs.purpose: Tracks new scholarly publications with stable queries and deduplicated updates.

packs.title: Qualitative research
packs.purpose: Supports traceable coding, excerpts, reflexive notes, and thematic synthesis.

packs.title: Research images
packs.purpose: Keeps image identity, transformations, measurements, exclusions, and interpretation traceable.

packs.title: Systematic review
packs.purpose: Supports reproducible searching, screening, deduplication, and inclusion decisions.

packs.title: Combined document-and-data route
packs.purpose: Connects document evidence with table and dataset analysis in one research route.

packs.title: Complete research-cycle route
packs.purpose: Connects research design with literature and publication work from start to finish.
